Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Manoj Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Vipul Kumar, learned
counsel for opposite party no.2 as well as Mr. Mayank Awasthi, learned A.G.A. for the State and
perused the material on record.

2.  This application u/s 482 has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 08.09.2020 along with the Summoning order dated 28.09.2020 and the entire proceeding of Case No.1025 of 2020, arising out of Case Crime No.236 of 2020, under Section 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Kotwali Kalpi, District- Jalaun, on the basis of compromise.

sentences.text: Earlier the applicant had approached this Court by means of filing Application U/S 482 No.19053 of 2024 (Dr. Vinay Pandey vs. State of U.P. and Another) in which on 22.07.2024, the following order was passed :-

entities.text: Vinay Pandey vs. State of U.P. and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred for quashing of the entire proceedings, including charge-sheet dated 08.09.2020 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 28.09.2020, of Criminal Case No. 1025 of 2020 (State Vs. Dr. Vinay Pandey and Another), arising out of Case Crime No. 236 of 2020,
under Sections - 498-A, 325, 323, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Kalpi, District- Jalaun, pending before the Court Judicial Magistrate, Kalpi, Jalaun.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 1025 of 2020 (State Vs. Dr. Vinay Pandey and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant has not pressed the prayer of quashing of proceedings and submitted that matter relates to matrimonial dispute between husband and wife and the said matter can be well considered in mediation.
Learned counsel further submitted that there are fair chances of compromise between the parties, if the matter is referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of the concerned district court.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection if matter is referred to mediation before the district court.

5. In view of aforesaid, it is directed that in case applicants move an application before the trial court for referring the matter to mediation before the District Legal Service Authority/Mediation Centre of the district court concerned, within a period of two weeks from today, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.

6. It is further directed that for a period of two weeks from today and in case matter is referred to mediation by the trial court, till the conclusion of the proceedings of mediation, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.

7. With the aforesaid observations, the instant application is finally disposed of."
4.

In compliance of the aforesaid order dated 22.07.2024 passed in (Dr. Vinay Pandey vs. State of U.P. and Another), the parties have appeared before the Mediation Centre at District- Jalaun and have arrived at a settlement, on the basis of which order dated 21.08.2024 has been passed after which the parties have decided to stay together.

entities.text: Dr. Vinay Pandey vs. State of U.P. and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Certified copy of the aforesaid mediation report as well as the order dated 21.08.2024 has been annexed as Annexure No.6 to this application.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that since the parties have settled their dispute and have entered into compromise, the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case may be quashed Dr. Vinay Pandey vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95899399/
2 by this Court.

entities.text: Dr. Vinay Pandey vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not dispute the correctness of the submissions as made by learned counsel for the applicant and states at the bar that the parties have entered into compromise and are staying together.

7. Learned A.G.A. for the State also accepts that the parties have entered into a compromise and the copy of the mediation report has also been enclosed along with order dated 21.08.2024, he has no objection, if the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed.

8. This Court is not unmindful of the following judgements of the Apex Court:
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and Another; (2003)4 SCC 675,
(ii). Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation; (2008) 9 SCC 677,
(iii). Manoj Sharma Vs. State and Others; (2008) 16 SCC 1,
(iv). Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab; (2012); 10 SCC 303,
(v).

Reference may also be made to the decision given by this Court in Shaifullah and Others Vs. State of U.P. &
Another; 2013 (83) ACC 278 and Pramod & Another Vs. State of U.P. & Another (Application U/S 482 No.12174 of 2020, decided on 23rd February, 2021) and Daxaben Vs. State of Gujarat, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 936 in which the law expounded by the Apex court in the aforesaid cases has been explained in detail.

sentences.text: 10. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, the court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose shall be served by prolonging the proceedings of the above mentioned criminal case as the parties have already settled their dispute.

11. Accordingly, the entire criminal proceedings the charge sheet dated 08.09.2020 along with the Summoning order dated 28.09.2020 and the entire proceeding of Case No.1025 of 2020, arising out of Case Crime No.236 of 2020, under Section 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Kotwali Kalpi,
District- Jalaun, on the basis of compromise, are hereby quashed.
12. The application is, accordingly, allowed.
There shall be no order as to costs.

Kalp Nath Singh
